title: Empty synthesis page contradicts itself and offers actions with nothing to act on
where: /admin/sessions/<code>/synthesis, session with no summaries and no points, 1440px
what_happens: It shows 'The latest summary includes every answer so far.' and, below, 'No summaries yet.' The 'Where did this come from?' search and a dark primary 'Rebuild summary now' are both shown though there is nothing to search or summarise.
who_hurts: An organizer opening a new session's synthesis is told there is a latest summary when there isn't, and the strongest button on the page invites a rebuild that can only fail.
suggested_fix: When summaries.length === 0: say 'No summary yet. It's written once people have answered.' and hide FindSources; when there are no points, hide or disable Rebuild. synthesis/page.tsx:157-163.
rule: general: empty state should say what will appear and when
